translations.translatedText: # Friday 18.11.2022 (radio)

The opposition submitted an interpellation on the situation in agriculture. The editor-in-chief of Helsingin Sanomat resigned. Finland is building a test fence on the eastern border. Apartment prices may fall. Weather forecast.
## Interpellation on the situation in agriculture

![Antti Lepola threshes grain from a field with a tractor in spring in Ohkola.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5798,h_3261,x_0,y_334/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-1005522631b0f1a38c88/1662719701)
Open image viewer
Farm costs have risen a lot, because many things have become more expensive. Photo: Janne Järvinen / Yle

The opposition has submitted an interpellation to the government on agriculture. Opposition parties are the parties that are not in the government. The interpellation is supported by the National Coalition Party, the Finns Party, the Christian Democrats and Liike Nyt. They say that the government does not understand the crisis on farms.
The opposition asks the government whether it takes care of Finnish farms and food production. Farms are having a hard time, because the prices of fuel, fertilisers and electricity have risen a lot.
The opposition says that farms must be helped, for example with electricity support and tax relief.
## Resignation of the editor-in-chief of Helsingin Sanomat

![Kaius Niemi in the lobby of the courthouse on Wednesday 5 October 2022.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5472,h_3078,x_0,y_114/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-1016943633d5e3dea1fc/1664966328)
Open image viewer
Kaius Niemi has been very much in the public eye because of the Helsingin Sanomat article about the army's signals intelligence centre. Photo: Jani Saikko / Yle

Kaius Niemi, the editor-in-chief of Helsingin Sanomat, has resigned from his job as editor-in-chief. The reason is that Niemi is suspected of gross drunk driving. Niemi may have driven a car while very drunk.
The board of Sanoma, the media company that owns Helsingin Sanomat, has released Niemi from his job as editor-in-chief. Helsingin Sanomat is the largest newspaper in Finland.

Kaius Niemi's name has been much in the public eye, because a court case against Helsingin Sanomat journalists is under way. The court case concerns news stories about the army's signals intelligence centre.
## Building a fence on the eastern border
![Map showing the place of the test fence. ](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1922,h_1079,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-10357826377398ff015f/1668771038)
Open image viewer
The map shows with a dashed line the place where the test fence will be built. Photo: Aurora Ferm / Yle
Finland is building a test fence on the eastern border. The fence will be 3 metres high and 3 kilometres long. Building the test fence starts in March and takes about 3 months.

Finland is building about 200 kilometres of fence on the eastern border in total. Construction will start in the spring with the test fence. The fence protects Finland's eastern border from hybrid influence, that is, a situation where Russia may send many asylum seekers to the border.
The aim is to prevent a situation where many people enter Finland illegally. People who want to come to Finland will be directed by the fence to border guard stations.
## Apartment prices
![Real estate agent's sign in front of an apartment.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3460,h_1946,x_3,y_533/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-1016939633d5d336cc8b/1673530560)
Open image viewer
HYPO predicts that apartment prices will fall by 2-3 percent next year.  Photo: Henrietta Hassinen / Yle
Apartment prices will fall in Finland next year. This is what the Finnish Mortgage Bank Hypo predicts. Hypo grants housing loans. That is why it follows the housing market closely.
Hypo predicts that apartment prices across Finland will fall by 2 percent next year. In Helsinki, apartment prices may fall by 3 percent.
Apartments have become cheaper since the summer, because many problems have come to the economy.
## The weather
![Saturday's weather map.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12679043)
Open image viewer
Snow is falling on the southern coast.

On Saturday, much of the country will be dry, that is, no rain. It will be partly cloudy and partly sunny. There will be snowfall on the southern coast. The temperature is between -1 and -5 degrees. It is colder in Lapland.
